about.text: Fermented camel's milk of the Somali herders of eastern Ethiopia, left to sour on its own in a clean or smoked container; the smoke, from woods such as wild olive, helps it keep.

links.name: Seifu, Livestock Research for Rural Development (2007)

facts.v: Fresh camel milk is kept at 25–35 °C for 12–24 hours in a clean, smoked container with glowing splinters of wild olive wood, wrapped in cloth; fermentation starts by back-slopping

sources.text: Its names and facts, from these.
